notes.title: Patch 1.0.7a
notes.notes:
-The bug on the prince scene has been fixed. Now, if you didn't watch the whole scene, the menu will be working.

If you find any problem, feel free to report us on Discord or on the game forum.

Cheers,

H-Room Team

notes.title: Small Patch (Bug on Horny Tower 12F)
notes.notes:
- Some people have found a bug on Horny Tower 12F, specifically on the shooting gallery that stops to works. Now, it's fixed. If you have found this bug, leave this floor through the level exit and return to it.

Feel free to report any bugs by joining Discord or using the game forum. Also, don't forget to follow my Steam page to get the latest news!

Cheers,

Pieve
